bac-2026.note: Rights-safe projection of the institution rows of the MESRS BAC 2026 placement file (PDF sha256 ca4b24e656296aa6c6ea360d7f53578077e8ea06cbc74c3c8390f1f197e7207e, 2382999 bytes, 350 pages): the ministry's establishment code and official French name only. The per-filiere minimum averages, the paramedical INFSPM/INFSSF rows (R codes) and the twin-offer pseudo-codes (F codes) are not projected. The PDF itself is not committed.

osm-campus-objects.note: Live re-read from the OSM editing API of every element named by the campus Claims of the 2026-10-28 Review queue (research/enseignement-superieur/precision-review-2026-10-28.json, read from the 2026-08-03 Overpass capture osm-campuses.json) and of the four BAC 2026 additions P08/P09/P10/P23 (seeds/bac-2026.json place.osm), for the ADR 0001 second-source check. Per element: version, timestamp, visibility (a deleted one is read from its history), all tags, and its point: a node's lat/lon, a way's or relation's bounding-box centre of its nodes (Overpass `out center`), plus records, the point the Claim was read at (capture_point) and moved_m between the two. Projection written by research/enseignement-superieur/fetch-second-sources.mjs; ODbL.

overture-places.note: Overture Maps Places release 2026-10-21.0 (CDLA-Permissive-2.0, attribution: Overture Maps Foundation), the rows whose website host or name ties to a record of this package and that serve as its single open campus lead (Owner decision of 2026-10-29). Every row here is Meta-sourced, none OSM-derived.

wikidata-campuses.note: Wikidata items that could be the same institution as a record of the 2026-10-28 campus Review queue or a BAC 2026 addition, for the ADR 0001 second-source check: the live OSM element's wikidata tag, a wikibase:around search within 5 km of each Claim point for P31/P279* Q38723/Q3918/Q2385804/Q3914, and an MWAPI EntitySearch on the record's French and Arabic names (full, without parenthesis or ex-tail, and the part before the dash), a search hit kept only when its P17 is Q262 or a P625 value lies in Algeria. Per item only P625 (every value, with rank), P856, P31, P402, P17 (with rank) and the fr/ar/en labels and aliases, plus found_by, the lead that brought it in. All read over the SPARQL endpoint because www.wikidata.org/w/api.php answered HTTP 429 on 2026-10-28. Written by research/enseignement-superieur/fetch-second-sources.mjs; CC0.
